$comment: pulley/registry/blocks/notify/manifest.json — created 2026-08-13 (T-13): the notify core block. An in-app inbox per user plus outbound email through the MAIL PORT, and the first block that both CONSUMES a port and SHIPS an adapter for it. `providesAdapters` puts a Resend adapter in the app's registry; `ports:["mail"]` says the block needs a selection; PULLEY_PORT_MAIL is what actually picks one. That chain — ship, select, resolve, with no vendor import anywhere in block code — is the end-to-end proof that T-10b/G6 closed. Depends on auth: notify_notification references auth_user by id and the inbox is session-scoped, so auth installs and migrates first. `packages` ranges are byte-identical to auth's and org's on purpose (the installer refuses incompatible ranges of one package across blocks). DATABASE_URL is declared with flags identical to auth's, which the resolver treats as a shared variable rather than a conflict. Updated 2026-08-17 (G7): `events.consumes` is no longer documentation. `hooks.init` points at server/eventsInit.ts, which subscribes this block to the app's event bus at startup, so an org.member.joined event becomes an inbox row with no import between the two blocks — and note that org is NOT a dep: an app without org just never fires the subscription.
name: notify
description: Per-user notification inbox with mark-read endpoints, plus transactional email through the mail port and a Resend adapter.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Postgres connection string the notification inbox lives in. Same database as the auth block — notify_notification holds a foreign key into auth_user.

env.name: RESEND_API_KEY
env.description: API key for the Resend mail adapter this block ships. Required only when PULLEY_PORT_MAIL=resend; an app on the memory adapter never reads it, which is why this is requiredWhen rather than required (G26).

env.name: NOTIFY_MAIL_FROM
env.description: Default sender address for notification email, e.g. "Acme <alerts@acme.com>". Required in practice whenever PULLEY_PORT_MAIL=resend and a caller does not set a per-message from; the adapter refuses to send without one rather than guessing.

env.name: NOTIFY_DEDUPE_WINDOW_MINUTES
env.description: How long a notification's dedupe key suppresses an identical repeat. Defaults to 60. Must be a non-negative integer; 0 disables suppression.
